mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.5% signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to outperform baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 2.5% for 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 3.8% triggers a labor market tightening effect, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing below 3.8% in the next month (as per historical data).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in economic demand (GDP growth) signal accommodative monetary policy and expanded business activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to rise above baseline when both FEDFUNDS < previous month's value and GDPC1 > previous month's value.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a combination of falling unemployment rates below 4% and decreasing federal funds rates below 2% amplifies market optimism, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns do not outperform baseline in late-cycle regimes despite meeting trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 indicates expanding supply chains and reduced inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to rise above baseline when INDPRO continues its upward trajectory for 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 signals a robust labor market, fostering consumer spending and corporate investment, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite PAYEMS surpassing 150,000 in the next month (as per historical data).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rates below 2.5% and a rise in CPI inflation below 5% creates market uncertainty but signals eventual rate hikes, prompting cautious optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to rise above baseline when both conditions are met in a tightening regime.

mechanism_narrative: In a recovery phase, a surge in GDP growth (GDPC1) above 18,000 coupled with falling unemployment rates below 4% signals economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns do not outperform baseline in recovery phases despite meeting trigger conditions.
